law: If a capability exists on main only as a stub or fake path, it does not exist as product. Remove it from main. Keep the code on backup/stubs-channels. Open a restore issue. That issue is the roadmap row.

gates.verify: just verify. Serial scenario runners. Skips live Linq, live fiscal, KIND reliability, scale.
gates.verifyV1: just verify-v1. Signed production evidence only. Missing or fixture-as-production fails closed.
gates.verifyActivation: just verify-activation. Signed activation evidence. Same fixture rule.
gates.note: Green just verify is not a V1 release. Green just verify-v1-fixtures is a labeled contract, not production.
